definitions.study_hours: sum gym, other, communicate_roadmap, vocabulary_roadmap, onion_gpt; hours proxy, possible module overlap
definitions.study_day: sum of five modules > 0; excludes lesson count from criterion
definitions.checkin_day: observed daily source row even if recorded hours zero
definitions.window: N days inclusive day 0 through N-1 from earliest Pro activation; must be within observation bounds
definitions.zeros: Missing user-days treated as zero recorded activity only under complete tracking assumption; no numeric missing values observed.
definitions.fixed_weekly_cohort: activation through observation_end minus 90 days; all 13 weeks use same users
definitions.W8: zero-based week 8, days 56-62; requires 63-day observation; early week days 0-6
definitions.invalid_chronology: install_date > active_at OR expire_date < active_at; retained primary, excluded sensitivity
definitions.row_exclusions: Remove flagged logged rows only, denominator unchanged; these are reduced-recorded-hours bounds, not corrected truth
definitions.user_exclusions: Remove entire users with a flagged row in analyzed window; creates selected population
definitions.long_windows: 120/150 days are operational approximations for 4/5 months
definitions.renewal_limits: Earliest activation may precede repeat purchase; plan and expiry cannot reconstruct purchase episodes
definitions.statistical_limits: Associations are descriptive, observational; CIs do not cover tracking bias or prove causality

retention_decomposition_w0_w12.identity: study minutes per eligible calendar day = study retention * study days per studying user * minutes per study day / 7
retention_decomposition_w0_w12.note: Arithmetic decomposition, not causal attribution. Log shares sum to one.
